name: @tomgrv/vps-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Tunnel as the private network (alternative to Tailscale)

CLOUDFLARE_PRIVATE_IP.description: Address WARP clients use to reach this VPS through the tunnel (a /32 on a dummy interface)

CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token (Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels)

PURGE_CLOUDFLARED.description: Also remove the cloudflared package on down (true/false)
